items.text: Morad Vaisi stated that Israel has changed the names of 14 highways and streets in Tehran over the past year. He said Israel targets IRGC commanders and Tehran's city council is changing street names according to Israel's plan.

Iranian football has experienced multiple failures and defeats in recent years under Mehdi Taj's leadership. The Guinea-Bissau football team refused to play a friendly match with the Iranian national team. This issue was discussed in the Hat-Trick program with a conversation by Mazdak Mirzaei.

Ali Fadavi stated that the US cannot exert full control with air power alone and requires ground presence. He added that the damage to the US and its allies is not comparable to that of the Islamic Republic. Fadavi claimed that the Islamic Republic's deterrence is unprecedented.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that if the current trend continues, Israel may rename more streets and highways in Tehran and other cities. He considers the possibility of Israel entering a new war and the killing of Iranian officials more serious.

The Islamic Republic has not agreed to Hamas's request to resume financial support. This decision may indicate Tehran's dissatisfaction with Hamas's performance. A Middle East analyst says Israel views Hamas's threat as part of a network of threats supported by the Islamic Republic.

Morad Vaisi stated that six people in Tehran are identified as members of the decision-making committee on negotiation and war with the US. The first three lean towards agreement with the US, while the latter three prefer continued confrontation. All of them face public anger from protesters.

The US stated after the Islamic Republic delegation's trip to the UN that Tehran did not offer a new proposal to reduce tensions. The US has also strengthened its military presence in Israel and the region. The main goal of the US is to prevent the Islamic Republic from obtaining nuclear weapons.

Jorge Jesus commented on Cristiano Ronaldo's status in the Portugal national football team, saying everything is open and Ronaldo can return whenever he wants. Ronaldo left the national team camp after being benched in the match against Norway and promised to reveal his reasons in due time. This issue has caused a major controversy in world football.

Mehdi Taj announced that according to the new AFC stadium standards, no stadium in Iran currently holds an A rating. Only Pars Shiraz Stadium has received a B license. This news was discussed in the Hattrick program.

The US has returned all B-1 bombers stationed at the RAF Fairford base in the UK to the United States. These aircraft were used in attacks on missile sites of the Islamic Republic. Several suspects were arrested near the base with possible involvement of the Islamic Republic suggested, but Tehran has denied the accusation.

Amirsalar Davoodi, a lawyer, announced the marriage of Alireza Sepahi and Mahshad Keshani in prison. They were engaged before their arrest and are both currently in prison. Alireza Sepahi is accused in the case of detainees from the December protests in Isfahan.

The Australian government has extended sanctions against Abdolreza Shahlaei and several senior commanders of the IRGC. New sanctions have also been imposed on eight members and one entity linked to Hamas. These sanctions are due to the individuals' roles in the military and financial activities of Iran's proxy groups and Hamas.

The office of Prince Reza Pahlavi warned about the risk of execution for Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raeisi and called on organizations and activists to act to prevent the execution. The execution of Alireza Sepahi was postponed due to a heart attack. His marriage ceremony with Mahshad Keshani was held in prison.

Widespread student protests continue in France. Over 400 high schools across the country have been closed due to the protests. The protesters demand more teacher recruitment and improved education conditions.

Alireza Sepahi, a protester sentenced to death in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan, has been transferred to solitary confinement in Dastgerd prison. Mohammad Olyaiefard warned about serious legal flaws in the case and forced confessions under torture. He stated that carrying out the sentence would constitute a state-sanctioned killing.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi stated that the deployment of about three thousand American troops in Israel and reports of sending more forces and equipment indicate that the US is preparing for a new round of conflict with the Islamic Republic. He added that diplomatic negotiations have not succeeded and the Islamic Republic's conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz have not been accepted. Namvar Haghighi emphasized that without Tehran's strategic review, the Islamic Republic's diplomacy will not succeed.

Pegah Bani Hashemi spoke about the phone marriage of Alireza Sepahi and Mahshad Keshani. She said the Islamic Republic accelerates executions in critical conditions. International pressure to stop the execution of protesters is important.

The National Emergency Organization announced that from the beginning until October 3rd, four people were killed and 579 injured in weather-related incidents. Two people died due to floods and two due to lightning. Additionally, one person is missing in the flood.

Kayhan newspaper highlighted the differences between the behavior of Iranian police and Western police during student protests in France. Kayhan described Iranian police as being alongside the people and using a model of tolerance and dialogue. The newspaper criticized the actions of American and European police on university campuses.

The Kepler report shows that Middle East oil exports have risen above pre-war levels. The US has reduced the IRGC's ability to disrupt the Strait of Hormuz through its attacks. Additionally, the increase in US forces and new military arrangements in the region indicate a possible quick return to military options.

The Australian government has extended financial sanctions related to counter-terrorism financing against four members of the IRGC. These individuals have been involved in attacks and killings outside Iran. The sanctioned individuals are Abdolreza Shahlaei, Mansour Arbabseir, Ali Gholam Shakouri, and Hamed Abdollahi.

Mohammad Bayat, a member of parliament, described Iran's armed forces' capabilities as unparalleled and stated that enemies have repeatedly experienced the country's defensive power. He added that enemy threats and Trump's boasts have no effect on the Iranian people's resolve. These statements may continue but will not change Iran's defensive realities.

Abdolhossein Rouholamini, Tehran's representative in parliament, commented on the status of the Strait of Hormuz and rising oil prices. He questioned why oil prices are increasing if the Strait of Hormuz is open. He also emphasized that oil shipments pass through the strait with the approval of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

Alireza Sepahi and Mahshad Keshani, detainees from the January 2026 protests, married each other via phone calls from prison. Alireza Sepahi is sentenced to death, and Mahshad Keshani has been sentenced to five years in prison. Reports indicate that at least 33 protesters have been executed and over 100 others face the threat of execution.

In the third week of the Iranian women's Premier League, Esteghlal and Gol Gohar drew 3-3. The match was exciting and high-scoring. Mozdak Mirzaei had an interview with Raha Pourbakhsh on the Hattrick program.

Mehdi Taj, the head of the Football Federation, appointed Mohammadreza Sakat as the new head of the Professional Licensing Committee. Sakat was previously the CEO of Sepahan and has a record of extensive violations. This appointment was made despite the controversies regarding his past misconduct.

According to initial reports, a police patrol in Bampor County was attacked. Tasnim News Agency reported that two people have been killed in this incident so far. The incident occurred in Sistan and Baluchestan province.

Hossein Ghazian stated that about 70,000 nurses in Iran are staying home. He attributed this situation to an imbalance between workforce, job, salary, and living costs. He also noted that education and healthcare are facing deterioration.

Hamid Pourmohammadi, head of the Planning and Budget Organization, stated that the government currently has no plans to increase salaries of employees and retirees again. This month's priorities include reopening schools and universities, paying wheat farmers' claims, and people's livelihood. Also, the amendment bill for the seventh development plan is expected to be submitted to the parliament in October.

A video shows the moment of demolition of the watchtower of Gohardasht prison in Alborz province. The closure process of this prison began in August 2023 with the transfer of prisoners to Qezel Hesar prison. This action is part of the closure of Rajai Shahr prison.

Pedro Proença, president of the Portuguese Football Federation, confirmed Cristiano Ronaldo's exceptional position in the national team. He stated that Ronaldo is the best player in Portugal's history and will remain in the team as long as he is fit. He also mentioned that the recent disagreement between Ronaldo and Jorge Jesus was an internal misunderstanding.

The National Security Commission of the Parliament has passed a law to suspend Iran's cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency until the security of nuclear sites and scientists is ensured. This action follows threats and damages to nuclear centers and the martyrdom of scientists. The parliament member emphasized that the claims by the US and Europe regarding Iran's cooperation are not justifiable.

The Football Federation's Appeal Committee rejected the protests of Sepahan and Mes Shahrbabak clubs against Yaser Asani's presence in Esteghlal's lineup. The disciplinary committee's ruling acquitting Esteghlal and this player was confirmed. Persepolis's complaint against Esteghlal and Asani remains open in the Appeal Committee.

Mehdi Moslehi referred to the Kepler report stating that Middle East crude oil exports have risen above pre-war levels. Exporting countries and buyers have managed to maintain the flow of oil trade. The Islamic Republic has not been able to realize its claim to stop regional oil exports.
Videos sent to Iran International show the poor condition of the boys' dormitory at the University of Zabol. Students have reported broken furniture and lockers, and the dormitory is dirty.

Mohammad Amin Aghamiri stated that Iran managed to disable all Starlink terminals in a controlled manner. He mentioned that other technologies are ready to be used if the Islamic Republic decides to do so. Aghamiri described Starlink as a military tool and announced readiness for appropriate action.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the Governor of the Central Bank, stated that after failing in military war, the US and Israel have entered an economic war targeting the financial sector and currency market. The Central Bank acts within its legal authority to manage the currency market. He also said that enemies hoped to cause severe economic turmoil through rising liquidity and inflation, but they will not succeed.

The Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister of Pakistan, along with a political and military delegation, are traveling to Riyadh to attend a trilateral meeting between Pakistan, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia. The meeting is held within the framework of the Makkah defense pact. It coincides with intensified Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia.
A citizen sent a video showing government nighttime protesters causing noise and disturbance for people. The video was sent to Iran International. The issue concerns nighttime gatherings.

Sadegh Masoumi, Secretary General of the Stability Front, warned about cultural laxity in society reaching the point of nudity. He stated that officials remain neutral and only watch this process. Masoumi emphasized that abandoning the issue of hijab will lead to the breaking of cultural barriers.

Ali Fadavi mentioned his wife's role in founding 97 branches of Shajareh Taybeh schools in southern Iran during a news program. His wife was killed in the 12-day war. The Shajareh Taybeh school in Minab was targeted on the first day of the 40-day war, resulting in civilian casualties.

Israel will begin official ceremonies for the third anniversary of the October 7 attack on Monday. The main ceremony will be held at Mount Herzl in Jerusalem with senior political and security officials and representatives of victims' families. Isaac Herzog, Benjamin Netanyahu, Yisrael Katz, and Eyal Zamir are among the attendees.

Reports from various cities in Iran indicate that people face severe economic hardships and political pressures. Families cannot afford school expenses, and schools are under the supervision and control of security and political forces. Workers also face low wages and unpaid insurance.

During the speech of Hossein Rahimi, head of economic security police, the electricity at the venue was cut off. The speech was about the increase in the dollar price. This incident happened during the speech.

Ahmad Bakhshaish Ardestani said mediators lack sufficient power and countries like Saudi Arabia and the UAE obstruct the efforts of Qatar and Oman. He also mentioned the possibility of a short-term US attack after Iran's elections and stated that Iran is prepared. Bakhshaish Ardestani added that Trump might target the Islamic Republic due to concerns about his own assassination.

On World Teachers' Day, at least 47 active and retired teachers in Iran are imprisoned, detained, or exiled. Among them, 13 are serving prison sentences, 32 are in temporary detention, and 2 are undergoing exile. These individuals are spread across 19 provinces.

Ali Abdollahi warned that if a new war begins, its fire will engulf everyone. He stated that the armed forces will target the interests of the US or Israel if they take action. He also warned international organizations against baseless remarks about Iran's nuclear sites.

Morteza Kazemian stated that after six months of ceasefire, relations between Iran and the US remain in a 'neither war nor peace' and highly unstable state. He said the increased economic and military pressure from the US is not a sign of agreement and a full-scale war is possible. He also warned that this situation could lead to increased livelihood pressures and a social explosion.

A group of defrauded customers of the OMP Finex exchange protested on Tuesday, October 5, in front of the Attorney General's building. They were protesting the non-payment of their claims. This protest was reported through videos received by Iran International.

Behrouz Mohibi, a member of the Parliament's Budget and Planning Commission, criticized Iran's economic dependence on the US dollar, saying the money of an enemy country has become our master. He also stated that America's audacity stems from the belief that the spirit of revenge has weakened. The parliament member added that Iran is among the five richest countries in terms of resources.

Benjamin Netanyahu said on the third anniversary of the October 7 attack that it marked the start of Iran's plan to destroy Israel. He described a threefold threat including proxy groups, deadly missiles, and a nuclear explosion. Netanyahu added that Israel has responded to these threats and established buffer zones.

Lionel Messi is set to play his last official match for the Argentina national team against Benin early Wednesday. He missed the last two games but recently returned to training with the team. The players and coaching staff welcomed him back.

Hossein Aghaei from Iran International referred to the New York Times report about the rapid exit of US bombers from the Fairford base. Washington still considers the security threat against its forces and equipment at this base serious. One concern is foreign espionage, especially by China and the Islamic Republic.

A citizen from Khorramabad addresses Benjamin Netanyahu in a video, saying they are waiting to celebrate Iran's freedom next year. He refers to Netanyahu's promise. The video was sent to Iran International.

Messages and images from several universities indicate poor dormitory conditions and disorder in class schedules. Students at Zabol University reported dirty dormitories and missing personal belongings. Additionally, the presence of security and Basij forces has increased, with students being confronted under the pretext of coverage.

Reza Alipour, the second place winner in speed climbing at the Nagoya Asian Games, spoke about the problems in Iran's sports system after returning to Iran. He said the conditions in Iran are not suitable and the system is to blame. Alipour also stated that he has not retired and will continue to pursue his goal.

Benjamin Netanyahu stated that Israel will not allow the Islamic Republic to threaten its existence. He said Israel has struck ballistic missile and nuclear facilities of the Islamic Republic. Netanyahu emphasized that this threat cannot be left to future generations.
Hossein Rahimi, head of economic security police, stated that websites publishing false currency prices in the country will face judicial and police action based on the Tehran prosecutor's directive.

A citizen sent a video showing armed agents of the Islamic Republic arresting a person in an alley of Phase 2 of Parand city. The video also reports gunfire. This incident was reported by Iran International.

Mehdi Fazeli stated that Iran is the fourth power in the world after the USA, China, and Russia. He added that analysts today acknowledge the emergence of this new power. Mojtaba Khamenei also described Iran as the first power in the world based on divine calculations.

In an armed attack on the police patrol at Nokjoo station on the Bampur to Iranshahr route, two police officers were killed and one was injured. This incident was reported by Mahdi Nakhl Ahmadi, a journalist and political activist.

The winners of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine were announced in Stockholm. The prize was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel for discovering light-controlled ion channels and developing optogenetics. This method allows scientists to control the activity of nerve cells in the living brain using light.

A citizen in Tehran sent a video showing the slogan "Long live the Shah" written on a wall. He addresses supporters of the government, saying the slogan was erased but rewritten. This video was sent to Iran International.

Mai Sato, the UN special rapporteur on human rights in Iran, expressed concern about the execution sentence of Alireza Sepahi, a protester from December 2025. She criticized the torture of Sepahi's family and the fairness of the trial. The Islamic Republic's judiciary has not yet commented on the execution.

The death sentences of Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raeisi, two detainees from the December 2025 protests, were carried out on Monday morning, October 4. Previously, two other protesters in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan were executed. Mahshad Keshani, Alireza Sepahi's wife, was sentenced to five years in prison.

In the third week of the women's Premier League, players' families attended the matches at the stadium. This year, men were allowed to attend the stadium for the first time. Previously, matches were held only with female spectators.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported that a tanker near 11 miles north of Khasab, Oman, was forced to change course by orders from the IRGC. The IRGC demanded the tanker to change its route and threatened to target it otherwise.

Arman Gorjian, a 19-year-old student, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Babamidan Mamasani. His father mentioned his death during a birthday ceremony held at his grave. He said Arman was killed at a time when discontent exploded.

Hassan Qashqavi, spokesperson for the National Security Commission of the Parliament, stated that the security of Iran and its neighbors is interconnected. He warned that if infrastructure is attacked, Iran will respond in kind. Qashqavi also emphasized that people are justified in defending the homeland and that the enemy aims to destroy Iran.

Ruhollah Rahimpour noted the increase of US military forces in Israel indicates serious preparation for renewed conflict. He added that the likelihood of conflict has risen due to stalled negotiations. He also stated that the main issue for the Islamic Republic is its resilience in case of war, which he considers low.

The Asian Football Confederation announced that the match between Al-Muharraq Bahrain and Gol Gohar Iran has been moved to Al-Seeb Stadium in Oman. The change was due to the failure to issue visas for the Gol Gohar team members by Bahrain. Gol Gohar club is trying to find a direct flight to Oman.

Protesters in Mashhad distributed leaflets in memory of the martyrs of the national revolution. The leaflets stated that behind every name there is a human and a family. This act was done to remind people of hopes for a better future.

Shina Ansari, head of the Environmental Protection Organization, reported that about 50% of organizational positions are vacant. In some provinces, the shortage of environmental rangers reaches 60%. She also emphasized the need to revise employee salary bases and use pollution levy revenues primarily to reduce pollution.

Ali Rafiei, head of Tehran's public places police, stated that Sanai and Iranshahr streets have become places for street vending. He added that people come to these streets without knowing what they want.

The official judiciary news agency reported the execution of Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raeisi in Isfahan Central Prison. One night before the execution, Alireza Sepahi married his fiancée, Mahshad Keshani, in prison. More details were provided in an interview with Reza Akvanian.

Alireza Raeisi, detained in December, was executed on Monday, October 4. His uncle reacted to the execution by releasing a video. This execution occurred after the disappearance and discovery of Ramin Raeisi's body.

Prince Reza Pahlavi's office announced that the Islamic Republic executed Alireza Raeisi and Alireza Sepahi, detainees of the National Lion and Sun Revolution. Alireza Sepahi married Mahshad Keshani in prison, and a heart attack delayed the execution for a while. The office warned that government killings will not go unanswered and that those responsible will be held accountable.

Hossein Ahmadi, detained in connection with the 1404 protests, remains in custody at Isfahan's Dastgerd prison after 143 days without a clear judicial status. He suffers from physical problems in his back and neck and has been deprived of proper medical care. He has been charged with moharebeh and operational actions against national security.

Mizan news agency reported the execution of Alireza Sepahi in Dastgerd prison in Isfahan on the early morning of October 4, 2026. Alireza Sepahi married his fiancée by phone before the execution and is the fourth detainee from the Dey 404 protests to be executed. These executions took place after a statement by 46 countries condemning executions in Iran.

A court session is being held in London's Royal Woolwich Court for three Iranians accused of cooperating with the Islamic Republic's intelligence service. The charges include planning violence against Iran International journalists. More details are provided in an interview with Tajeddin Soroush.

The judiciary of the Islamic Republic executed Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raeisi. Social media users tried to save them by widely sharing their images and names. News of a phone wedding between Alireza Sepahi and his fiancée Mahshad Keshani in prison was also circulated.

Videos sent to Iran International show the installation of supportive posters of Prince Reza Pahlavi on public walls in the city of Khorramabad. This action took place in public passages of the city. No further details have been provided.

The cost of living, especially for children's snacks, is very high and families face economic difficulties. Some families cannot afford school transportation due to high costs. There are also concerns about children's safety at school and the need for good phones for education.

Saeed Ajarlu, a member of the Islamic Republic's negotiation team, criticized the prediction of oil prices rising to $150. He stated that those who made such predictions should now be held accountable. He also commented on the possibility of Donald Trump losing the congressional elections.

The Israeli website Walla News reported that about three thousand American troops have been deployed in various parts of Israel. This news comes amid rising tensions and the possibility of a new round of conflicts between the US and the Islamic Republic. More details were provided in an interview with Maryam Rahmati.

An Omani co-pilot is accused of attempting to bring down a Flydubai plane en route to Tel Aviv. The incident occurred on October 8 on flight FZ1073 with over 170 passengers. The co-pilot attacked the Indian captain and tried to crash the plane into Ben Gurion Airport.
Zohreh Sarv, a political prisoner, was released from Evin prison after completing her sentence. The release took place on Monday, 13 Mehr. Harana News Agency reported this news.
A video shows a schoolgirl taking down pictures of Khomeini and Khamenei from the classroom board. The video was received by Iran International.

Abbas Mousavi stated that tensions are increasing and all sectors of the country must be on alert. He called for full defensive readiness and strengthening the country's war posture. Mousavi also emphasized that the Islamic Republic insists on its conditions in negotiations with the United States.

Alireza Zakani, the mayor of Tehran, unveiled the "Zero Inflation" plan aimed at keeping the prices of some goods fixed for six months. This plan was introduced amid record highs in the dollar price and increasing inflation pressure on people's daily lives. Farshad Motaghi analyzed this plan and its gap with people's real life in "Peyvast."

Esmaeil Kowsari stated that the suspension of cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency was due to the agency's performance and reports. He accused Rafael Grossi and the agency inspectors of providing false reports about Iran's nuclear activities. Kowsari described Iran's nuclear activities as legal and warned that any miscalculation in dealing with Iran would result in a severe blow.

Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, met with the Armenian foreign minister to discuss bilateral relations and developments in the Caucasus and West Asia. He also updated the Armenian minister on developments in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. Araghchi identified the US and Israel as the main causes of insecurity in the Strait of Hormuz and emphasized Iran's firm defense of its national interests.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations center received a report about an incident 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman. A tanker entering the Strait of Hormuz was called by the IRGC and ordered to turn back. It was also reported that a liquefied petroleum gas tanker was hit by an unknown projectile.
A video shows a kilometer-long line of vehicles in Zahedan waiting for fuel. The footage is from the evening of Sunday, October 4. The images were released by Iran International.

The governor of Faryab reported the death of a father and son due to a mine collapse. The incident occurred at 11 AM on Tuesday while working with a loader and excavator. Heavy rain and adverse weather conditions slowed down rescue operations.

Giorgia Meloni and Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan held a phone call discussing Middle East developments, regional security, freedom of navigation, and energy market outlook. The conversation addressed important regional and international issues. More details are available in an interview with an Iran International reporter.
A citizen sent a video showing a damaged vessel in Tanbak port, Kangan county. The vessel was targeted by air attacks during the war. The video was sent to Iran International.

Daniel Medvedev, the Russian tennis player, was disqualified from the China Open semifinal after hitting a ball that struck a spectator's eye. The incident occurred while Medvedev was losing, and the ball hit the left eye of a front-row spectator. Novak Djokovic expressed regret over the incident and said Medvedev did not intend to cause harm.

The Asian Football Confederation has requested additional documents regarding Yaser Asani's contract from the Iranian Football Federation. This request follows complaints from several clubs about Asani's contract status. AFC has also inquired about the notice sent by Asani and his communications with Esteghlal.

Mohsen Rezaei stated that every miscalculation by the enemy against Iran results in a heavy defeat. He warned that the next mistake will lead to new fronts and greater surprises. Rezaei emphasized that Iran will powerfully overcome the complex situation with the leadership of Mojtaba Khamenei and the support of the historic nation.

JD Vance, the US Vice President, stated that the US is reviewing its procedures following the Flydubai incident. He mentioned that no conclusive evidence has been found linking the Islamic Republic to the incident. These remarks were made on Monday, October 5.

Iran International reported that the dismissal of the oil minister is a step to continue the main oil sales corruption network in the IRGC intelligence. This network, coordinated by a senior IRGC commander and his son, has connected to the Russian banking system. This information was published exclusively.
A video sent to Iran International shows protesters in Semnan writing the slogan "Long live the Shah" on city walls. This action took place during protests. No further details have been provided.

An American official told Al Jazeera on Monday, 13 Mehr, that the US is tightening the siege on Iran. The official said that the country is facing economic problems and feels the pressure of this siege, and these pressures will continue.

The office of Reza Pahlavi reacted to the execution of Alireza Raeisi and Alireza Sepahi, stating that government killings will not go unanswered. They emphasized that all those responsible for this crime will be held accountable under the law. This statement was published on the social network X.
Today, a father and son working at the Biduieh chromite mine in Faryab county died due to a collapse. The incident occurred at the Biduieh chromite mine. The number of victims is two.

Retired employees of Sanandaj Telecommunications held a protest today as part of the ongoing Tuesday protests against unpaid claims and issues with supplementary insurance. They also criticized the CEO's lack of attention and regulatory bodies' negligence. The protest was held to demand their rights.

A video shows the ruins of Jannat Bazaar in Tehran eight months after the fire on 14 Bahman 1404. Tehran municipality officials have promised reconstruction, but shopkeepers say no action has been taken. The video was sent to Iran International on Sunday, 12 Mehr.

Abbas Mousavi, deputy of Masoud Pezeshkian's office, said the situation is moving towards increased tension. He emphasized the need to use all means to prevent the threat of war. He also stated that economic and military sectors should strengthen their war readiness.
A citizen reported in a video to Iran International that after several hours of water outage on Sunday, 12 Mehr, the tap water became heavily polluted and unusable.

Lili Mahdavi, mother of Siavash Mahmoudi, a teenager who died in the 1401 uprising, shared a photo of her son in football attire and recalled his first time entering Azadi Stadium. She wrote that Siavash entered the football field with enthusiasm and dreamed of becoming a football player. His mother expressed sorrow, wondering where that boy is now.

Ismail Baqaei, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, stated that countries providing facilities for US and Israeli attacks on the Islamic Republic must be held accountable. He described the Israeli ambassador's action at the UN as planned and said ignoring it is the best response. Additionally, the Armenian foreign minister's visit to Tehran aimed to strengthen bilateral relations and discuss stability in the South Caucasus.

The Teachers' Housing Cooperative project in Shushtar remains unfinished after 25 years. Delays have been caused by problems in providing water and electricity infrastructure and lack of cooperation from service agencies. This issue was shown in a video sent to Iran International.

Israel's Defense Minister Yisrael Katz stated that four thousand participants in the October 7 attack have been killed, with about two thousand remaining. He said orders have been given to pursue and eliminate all of them, from senior commanders to regular forces. This information was posted on the Defense Minister's X page.
Four death row prisoners in separate cases in Andika, Zanjan, Qeydar, and Tehran were released after the victims' families pardoned them.

Donald Trump wrote on Truth Social that the increase in gasoline prices is not due to the Strait of Hormuz, but rather the main problem is refineries. He pointed to Russian refineries targeted by Ukraine and American refineries in Democratic states that are being shut down.

US President Donald Trump attributed the rise in diesel prices to refineries, stating it no longer concerns the Strait of Hormuz. He claimed Russian refineries are targeted by Ukraine, and US refineries in Democratic-leaning states are being shut down. These remarks come amidst reports indicating an increase in oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz.

A student sent a video showing an image from the ninth-grade defense readiness textbook. In the image, Khamenei's ring is placed next to mice. This has been interpreted as the ring repelling mice but also indicating that Khamenei was next to the mice.

Al Nassr club announced that Cristiano Ronaldo has returned to team training. Ronaldo has returned to Saudi Arabia with a new style. Efforts to bring him back to the Portugal national team have so far been unsuccessful.

Parsa Najafi, a 19-year-old Bahá'í citizen, has been held in Isfahan's Dastgerd prison for over 120 days without a clear decision. His detention order has been extended again, and judicial proceedings have not yet started. The charges against him have not been announced.

The CEO of Kuwait Oil Company stated that Kuwait's oil production is about two million barrels per day, equivalent to 75% of the pre-war level. Despite threats from the Islamic Republic, ships continue to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. Kuwait has plans to build new pipelines through Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

Masoud Pezeshkian stated in a meeting with the Armenian foreign minister that the US is not seeking dialogue and aims to overthrow the Islamic Republic. He added that war has been imposed on Iran after every negotiation. Pezeshkian also emphasized that the Islamic Republic has proven its sincerity regarding nuclear activities.

Two people died in separate incidents at construction projects in Urmia and Royan. Nine people were injured in Royan, and the number of injured in the Ilam concrete pouring accident increased to three. These incidents involve workers.

The status of 37 dismissed workers from the second phase of Ilam Gas Refinery remains unclear after several weeks. The labor office and court have ruled for their reinstatement. The workers' situation is still uncertain.
A video shows a group of female students in a school in Isfahan chanting 'Long live the Shah'. They tear images of Khomeini from their textbooks. This video was received by Iran International.

Niusha Saremi mentioned in Titraval a major attack by Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government to retake Sanaa. This indicates a new front in the war with Tehran. The audio version of this program has been released.

Telecommunications retirees held protest gatherings on Monday, October 5, in Kermanshah, Isfahan, Tehran, and Sanandaj. The Tehran gathering included a march, and protesters in Sanandaj demanded payment of their dues and full implementation of regulation 89/24.

Mohammad Naderi, a 45-year-old political prisoner, was transferred without prior notice from Tehran Grand Prison to Qezel Hesar Prison in Karaj. He has been sentenced to death on charges of espionage. This transfer has raised concerns about the imminent execution of his death sentence.

Scott Bassett stated that the economic expulsion operation against Iran is yielding results and the rial has reached its lowest historical value. He said Iran has not exported any crude oil in the past month and is going through one of its toughest periods. The operation will continue until Iran changes its policies.

The Tehran Football Board issued initial sanctions for those involved in the clash between the youth teams of Esteghlal and Shahin. Nineteen players, coaches, and fans were banned from one month to one year, and Esteghlal club was banned from having fans for five matches. Financial fines ranging from 15 to 100 million tomans were also imposed on the offenders.

The website Ynet reported on Monday, 13 Mehr that Shin Bet agents have gone to the UAE to interrogate Hamam al-Hamami, the Omani co-pilot of Flydubai. He is accused of attempting to hijack and crash flight FZ 1073, and stated his motive was revenge against Israel for the Gaza war.
